text.jp:
主がお待ちです。
どうぞ中へお進み下さい。
text.official_en: My lady has been expecting you. Please, proceed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……それがしは、ただ
姫の決断に従うのみにござります。
text.official_en: I will go along with whatever milady desires.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どのような危険な場所に赴いたとしても、
この身に代えてお守り申し上げまする。
text.official_en:
No matter the danger, I will continue protecting you
even if it costs me my life.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アラゴ王国のアスワン王妃は、
先王ハスドルバルの実子でありながら――
text.official_en:
Queen Aswan is the natural-born daughter of King
Hasdrubal, Arago's late king.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
政治的実権は宰相と現国王に握られ、
傀儡のようなものだと聞いたことがある。
text.official_en:
Yet I hear that true political power lies with the
chancellor and new king, making her a puppet.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
王妃を支持していたものたちも
宰相らによって追われたとも……
text.official_en:
I also hear the chancellor systematically drove out all
of her supporters.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いずれにせよ、王妃殿下の立場は
微妙なものであるといえるだろう。
text.official_en:
All of which is to say that Her Majesty's place in the
kingdom is rather delicate.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのような相手からの
突然の誘いともなると……さて。
text.official_en:
For you to receive a sudden invitation from someone
in her position... Well.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
うふふ。晩餐会に参加できるなんて初めて！
ボク、なんだか夢みたいだよ。
text.official_en:
Hehe. This'll be my first time at a banquet! It's like
a dream.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
王様たちがいるような場所に呼ばれるなんて、
やっぱりレダさんはすごいや。
text.official_en:
You must be pretty great to get invited to a place
with kings and queens and stuff!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
失礼がないように、礼儀作法とか、
オリンピアさんに教えてもらわなくちゃ。
text.official_en:
Maybe I should ask Olympia for some etiquette
pointers so I don't stick my foot in it.
text.real_en: I'll have to ask Olympia-san to teach me some manners so I don't offend anyone.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あ、そういえばこの前、カーラ様が
簡単な詩の作り方を教えてくれたんだよ。
text.official_en:
Oh, that reminds me! The other day Kalla gave me a
poetry-writing lesson.
text.real_en:
Oh, that reminds me! The other day Cara-sama gave me a
poetry-writing lesson.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ボクそれで感激しちゃって……
カーラ様、とっても優しくて素敵だなあ。
text.official_en:
I was so thankful. Isn't Kalla just the kindest, most
wonderful woman you ever met?
text.real_en:
I was so thankful. Isn't Cara-sama just the kindest, most
wonderful woman you ever met?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ここに居られるうちに、いろんな人から
いろんな事を勉強させてもらわなくっちゃ！
text.official_en:
And now, while I'm here, I'm gonna learn all I can
from all sorts of people!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アスワン王妃のこと……
あたくしもよくわかりますわ。
text.official_en: I know all too well Queen Aswan's situation.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だって、権力に近い位置にいることは、
必ずしも自由ではありませんもの。
text.official_en:
After all, having authority does not necessarily mean
one has freedom.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あたくしは、そのような場所から逃げて、
カーラ様のもとに身を寄せたのですから。
text.official_en:
I fled from a situation similar to hers before finding
my place with Kalla.
text.real_en:
I fled from a situation similar to hers before finding
my place with Cara-sama.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここにいる限り、飲み水にも
湯浴みに用いる水にも苦労することもない。
text.official_en:
As long as you remain here, you will never want for
water to drink or bathe in.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この街の豊富で清廉な水は、
水道橋によってもたらされている。
text.official_en:
This city has a virtually endless supply of clean water
delivered by aqueduct.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
遠方の山からこの街に渡された水道橋も、
運ばれてきた水が都市を動かす仕組みも、
text.official_en:
The channels that stretch to the faraway mountains,
and the system distributing water through this city...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
どれも、妾の兄であり、鍛冶の神でもある
クレールが作り出したものだ。
text.official_en:
Both were created by my brother Credna, the Spark 
of the Forge.
text.real_en:
Both were created by my brother Claire, the Spark 
of the Forge.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……綺麗な水が手に入らない土地も多い中、
贅沢きわまりない話なのだろうな。
text.official_en:
Though...to cities lacking clean water, I'm sure it
would all seem an egregious extravagance.
